_doc: The world map (PLAN §0 ruling 33: hub + story-gated portals + a PoE-style map of nodes). One act = a town, its outdoor zones and its dungeons. `x`/`y` are 0-100 map-screen coordinates (y grows DOWN the screen, so the town is at the bottom and the act climbs toward the top right); they are a layout, not geography. `links` are the lines drawn between nodes AND the walkable connections (a zone's `exit` / `entrance` markers must match them). `portalAfter` is the story gate: the town portal to that node opens when the named node has been COMPLETED (a zone is complete when its far `exit` was reached; a dungeon when its boss died); `null` = open from the start. Dungeons have no portal of their own — they are entered from their zone's `entrance` marker, and `portalAfter` on a dungeon gates the entrance instead. `order` is the main-quest order (docs/ZONES.md). `built: true` = the JSON exists in data/zones (dungeons get data/dungeons later). `table` = the spawn table in data/monsters.json (same as the id). `floors` from the spawn tables. `rare` is the zone's named rare (data/monsters.json rares).

acts.name: Act 1 — The Bright Coast
acts.story: The Hollowhorn warband came down from the hills to raid the Brightwater coast, but their warlord Ruhk is only here to dig: under the Gravewatch hills lies the sealed catacomb of a king who never quite died. The diggers reached him first and became the Gravesworn. You follow the warband inland from the shore, dungeon by dungeon, until the warband is a sideshow and the dead king's household is waking up one hall at a time.

mainQuests.name: Crabs on the Landing
mainQuests.text: Elder Maudry Tern: the fisherfolk have fled Saltgrass Landing. Clear the beach and find out what drove them off.

mainQuests.name: The Beach Gate
mainQuests.text: Hill-folk have built a gate across the north beach. Reach it and see whose banner it flies.

mainQuests.name: Under the Headland
mainQuests.text: Something in the tidecaves is pulling the drowned back up. Kill Clatterjaw at the bottom of the pools.

mainQuests.name: The Miller's Cellar
mainQuests.text: The mill's stones have stood up and walked. Put Gristmaul down and open the road east.

mainQuests.name: The Brood Below
mainQuests.text: The wood road is webbed shut. Burn the egg sacs and kill Mother Thrum.

mainQuests.name: Toll Road
mainQuests.text: The warband has made the King's Road a chain of toll camps. Break every camp between here and the glade.

mainQuests.name: The Hall of Records
mainQuests.text: The diggers went into the Old Barrow and did not come back as diggers. Find their camp and the clerk who keeps the names.

mainQuests.name: The Wilted Verse
mainQuests.text: Ildreth's song keeps the fen gate shut. Interrupt the Last Verse.

mainQuests.name: The Drowned Bell
mainQuests.text: The Gravesworn are opening doors under the fen. Stop Sister Vennel ringing the bell.

mainQuests.name: Over the Pass
mainQuests.text: The only way to the warband's heights is Highcairn Pass, and the drakes have it.

mainQuests.name: The Black Stag
mainQuests.text: Warlord Ruhk is in the mine's deep gallery. End the warband.

mainQuests.name: The Sealed Lord
mainQuests.text: Four chanters are unsealing Harrowmund. Go down and stop the king getting up.
